description: Confirmed trips and how they run: loading, departure and closing.

empty.message: Trips appear here once a plan is confirmed. Open Planning to build one.
empty.title: No trips

confirm.acceptText: It will be recorded that {{carrier}} accepted the shipment. This is the final answer for this attempt.
confirm.rejectText: Give the reason the carrier gave: it is what the planner needs in order to decide what to do next.
confirm.sendText: {{carrier}} will be able to see it and answer. Its terms cannot be changed afterwards.
confirm.withdrawText: Say why it is being withdrawn. The carrier will no longer be able to answer it.

form.expiresAtHelp: Optional. After this moment the offer can no longer be accepted.
form.intro: The offer goes to the carrier of the planned vehicle and cannot be changed here. Everything else is optional.
form.notesHelp: What the carrier needs to know: loading time, gate, equipment.
form.offeredAmountHelp: Leave it empty when the shipment is billed under an agreed rate.
form.title: Offer the shipment

tender.none: This shipment has not been offered to its carrier yet.
tender.notOfferable: A shipment can only be offered while it is confirmed and has not left.
tender.title: Carrier tender

title: Trips

deliveries.deliveredAtHelp: When the goods changed hands, not when this is typed. The server refuses a future time, or one before the vehicle arrived.
deliveries.deliveredAtRequired: Say when the goods changed hands.
deliveries.notesHelp: Required for a partial, rejected or failed delivery: it is what gets read when the customer calls.
deliveries.notesRequired: Explain what happened to the goods.
deliveries.receiverDocumentHelp: Optional. Kept only so a disputed delivery can be settled.
deliveries.subtitle: Order {{order}} at stop {{stop}}.

dialogs.cancelReasonPlaceholder: Why this trip is not running
dialogs.cancelReasonRequired: Enter the reason: it is the only record of why a confirmed shipment was withdrawn.
dialogs.cancelText: {{number}} is cancelled and its orders return to the planning pool.
dialogs.completeText: {{number}} becomes completed. This is the final state and cannot be undone.
dialogs.dispatchText: {{number}} moves to In transit and the actual departure time is stored.
dialogs.readyText: {{number}} becomes ready for dispatch. The vehicle is re-checked right now.
dialogs.resolveNotesPlaceholder: Customer called, redelivery agreed for tomorrow
dialogs.resolveNotesRequired: Say what was done: "resolved" on its own records a click, not an outcome.
dialogs.resolveText: Closing the problem “{{type}}”. It stays on the trip as history.

evidence.capturedAtHelp: Optional, when the photo or signature was taken at another time.
evidence.fileHelp: An image or a PDF. The file is only reachable from the authenticated TMS.
evidence.subtitle: Proof of delivery for order {{order}}.
evidence.title: Attach evidence

problems.empty: Nothing has gone wrong on this trip.
problems.notesHelp: Required when the reason is Other, which says nothing on its own.
problems.stopHelp: Leave on the whole trip when the problem is not about one delivery.
problems.stopRequired: This reason is about a delivery: choose the stop it happened at.

subtitles.fail: The stop was attempted and could not be served. The reason is kept with the trip.
subtitles.report: A delay or a breakdown that has not changed any delivery yet.
subtitles.skip: The stop was never attempted. The reason is kept with the trip.

time.hint: Leave empty to record the current time.
time.label: Actual time

timeline.empty: Nothing has been recorded on this trip yet.
timeline.failed: The timeline could not be loaded. Everything that has already happened on the trip is still recorded.

toasts.error: The trip could not be updated

tracking.failed: The location could not be checked. The rest of the trip is up to date.
tracking.noProvider: This installation has no tracking provider configured.
tracking.noneReported: The provider has reported no position for this trip.
tracking.notOnTheRoad: The trip has not left yet, so there are no positions to show.
